title_zh: 选用海洋展的简短版语音导览

scenario.label_zh: 选用海洋展的简短版语音导览
scenario.goal_zh: 通过试听比较两个版本的语速和信息量，并选定简短版用于展览

context_zh: 海洋展览的工作人员在展厅听完两版语音导览后决定采用哪一版。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Holly
sentences.text: We've heard the full commentary and the short highlights version. Which would you use for this marine exhibition?

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: The latter. It covers fewer animals, but the speaker has time to pause between them.

sentences.speaker: Holly
sentences.text: The full version gives more names and facts. I struggled to keep up with it in this room.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: So did I. The shorter one is easier to follow, especially while looking at the tanks.

sentences.speaker: Holly
sentences.text: Let's use the short version in the exhibition and make the fuller text available to anyone who wants the detail.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll prepare the short audio for the listening stations.
